visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short black hair wearing a purple Adidas t-shirt and an older man with glasses wearing a black puffer vest sit on a light-colored floor. In front of them sits a large black box featuring the yellow text 'WBJ' and '2025'. An orange and white tabby cat walks across the foreground from right to left while the woman gestures toward the box. (2) The man leans forward and reaches into the opened black box, pulling out a green cylindrical bottle of shampoo. The woman takes the bottle, holding it close to the camera lens to show the label, 'SAHOLEA', while smiling and speaking. The setting is a brightly lit indoor room with a plain wooden door and a white wall in the background. (3) They continue to unpack the contents, revealing a peach-colored box labeled 'SALAD' and a grey box with yellow heart and star symbols. The tabby cat remains near their laps, sniffing at the various items spread out on the floor. The camera remains static at an eye-level medium shot throughout the interaction. (4) The woman holds up a package of sanitary pads with blue and pink branding, pointing at the text on the plastic wrap. The man pulls out a pink braided smartphone lanyard from a clear plastic bag and examines it curiously. The lighting is consistent, bright, and even across the subjects. (5) They present a white box with the text 'SIALIC ACID PROBIOTICS' and a logo for 'Better Biosciences' to the camera. In the final sequence, the man opens a small silver metal thermos, tilting it so the cat can sniff the opening while the woman watches from the side.
